text: Unit 3 of the Westhafen lignite power plant in Germany (660 MW) tripped unexpectedly on 12 March 2026 and is expected back by 15 March 2026.

The utility has extended the outage of the 900 MW Valmont 2 reactor in France until 30 September 2026 because of a cooling system inspection.
